errors.text_span: 从上至下按难度值由高到低排列
errors.evidence: The chart arranges the poems in ascending order of difficulty from top to bottom (from 5.717 to 7.191). The description incorrectly states they are arranged in descending order (from high to low).

errors.text_span: 宣州谢朓楼饯别校书叔云
errors.evidence: The character in the poem title is '眺' (tiào), but the description uses '朓' (tiǎo).
When listing the intermediate poems and their difficulty values, the description omits their genres (e.g., 七言古诗, 五言古诗), which are part of the labels on the y-axis.

errors.text_span: 且诗歌按难度值降序排列
errors.evidence: This repeats an earlier error. The poems are sorted by difficulty in ascending order from top to bottom, not descending (降序).
